output.brief: Cancelling RotaWeave would probably not fix this. Millbrook has used the app longest and has barely declined (118 to 111). Quarry Lane lost its coordinator but has no app, and it is also stable (86 to 80). Dock Street and Westgate have the app and lost their coordinator, and they fell by about half. The app's basic tier has no recurring bookings. Staff used to book regulars into their usual slots before each Thursday release (74 a week). Since 1 May that has dropped to 3 a week, and one admin seat sits unused. In May and June, 129 regulars at those two sites lost their usual slot at least twice, and 88% of them are now inactive. Of the 61 lapsed volunteers reached by phone, 44 said nobody booked them. The background check is not the cause. 121 of 123 lapsed volunteers held a current check, and the 21 deactivated for it came back. Commonplate shows little sign of mattering, and low satisfaction looks like a symptom. I'm fairly confident. Next steps: assign someone to book regulars into their usual slots at Dock Street and Westgate before each Thursday release, phone lapsed regulars to offer their slots back, and review after 60 days. Don't cancel the app, suspend the checks, or purge the roster figures.
